## license-pre-audit 1.1.0 Changelog

-首次运行自动识别当前操作系统 macOS / Liunx / Windows 是否有 node.js 环境 以及 skill 依赖环境，如果没有，自动安装并给出提示及安装进度。

Initial release of license-pre-audit: an intelligent pre-audit system for import/export license documents.

- Automatically extracts key fields (contract number, exporter/importer info, amount, quantity, weight, certificate number, manufacturer, customs port, etc.) from PDFs and images.
- Detects presence of official stamps and applies 11 audit rules.
- Supports command-line (CLI) usage with folders or archive files, and interactive chat-triggered audits.
- Generates both structured JSON and Markdown audit reports.
- Includes auto-dependency detection and installation for Python, poppler, tesseract, and other requirements, with cross-platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows).
- Provides sample configs, demo data, and supports multiple document and archive formats.
